core.title: Stainless Steel  Lever Pair, AHI SIG103

text.description_html:
AHI SIG103, Stainless Steel Lever Pair

This modern Cheyenne Door Lever is made from stainless steel and is a part of AHI Hardware's Sigma Series. The gentle curving shape not only adds a contemporary sleek look it fits nicely in the hand. Available in either satin stainless steel or polished stainless steel finishes.

Features of the Stainless Steel SIG1103 Lever:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Good for both residential and commercial applications.
  • Meets the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)

Specifications of the SIG103 Stainless Steel Lever Pair:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Lever Length: 5-1/2" (140 mm)
  • Lever Thickness: 3/4" (19 mm)
  • Projection: 2-3/8" (60 mm)

Includes pair of levers with spindle only. Rose, latch, strike and faceplate sold separately.
